articles.summary: Los Angeles, CA -- November 12, 2026 -- Today, eXoZymes Inc. (NASDAQ: EXOZ) (“eXoZymes”) - a pioneer in AI-enhanced biomanufacturing enabling commercial-scale production of rare natural molecules and novel medicines - announced the plan to host a webinar on Thursday, November 19, 2026, at 5:00 PM Eastern Time to discuss its results for the third quarter 2026. A press release detailing these results will be issued prior to the call.
articles.title: eXoZymes to Host Third Quarter 2026 update Conference Call on Thursday, November 19, 2026

articles.summary: Management to host Q3 2026 investor update at 5:00 PM ET / 2:00 PM PT today . Los Angeles, CA -- Nov 19, 2026 -- Today, eXoZymes Inc. (NASDAQ: EXOZ) (“eXoZymes”) - a pioneer of AI-enhanced enzymes that transform abundant feedstock into valuable nutraceuticals and novel medicines - will host an investor webinar at 5:00 PM Eastern Time to discuss results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, and provide an update on recent business developments.
